articles.title: Countries where you can buy iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cheaper than India

articles.body: Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max have officially launched worldwide, and as we have seen in the past, the price of these iPhones varies significantly from one country to another. The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max mark a slight shift in Apple’s flagship design and performance approach this year. Both models are powered by Apple’s new A20 Pro chip, which the company describes as its most capable iPhone processor to date, offering up to 40% better sustained performance compared to previous generations. On the display front, the iPhone 18 Pro comes with a 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR screen supporting ProMotion technology at up to 120Hz, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max steps up to a larger 6.9-inch display with the same specifications. The biggest change, however, comes in the camera. The main camera of these phones comes with a variable aperture tech, allowing users to have more control over their photos and videos.iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max: Cheapest country to buyIf you are considering buying either of these flagship models, it turns out several countries offer them at a noticeably lower price compared to India. This is due to differences in local taxes, import duties and currency conversion rates.ModelCountryPrice in RsiPhone 18 ProIndia Rs 1,64,900(Converted prices)United StatesRs 1,23,346JapanRs 1,24,090Saudi ArabiaRs 1,25,874UAERs 1,26,900SingaporeRs 1,31,295iPhone 18 Pro MaxIndiaRs 1,79,900(Converted prices)United StatesRs 1,33,634Saudi ArabiaRs 1,34,708UAERs 1,36,855SingaporeRs 1,45,123CanadaRs 1,48,044Based on current global pricing, the US offers the best deal on the iPhone 18 Pro, with buyers there saving considerably compared to Indian pricing. Japan follows closely behind on the same configuration. Saudi Arabia comes in next, while the UAE is not too far off either.The pattern holds fairly consistent for the larger iPhone 18 Pro Max as well. The US once again leads with the steepest discount. Saudi Arabia and the UAE follow with considerable savings. Singapore comes in next on the Pro Max, and Canada rounds out the list, making it another viable option for buyers looking to save on this larger model.Why iPhones cost more in IndiaThe consistent price gap between India and these markets largely comes down to how each country structures its taxes and import duties on electronics. Countries like the US and Japan tend to have comparatively lower tax on smartphones, which directly translates into lower retail prices for consumers.iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max launch: What’s new this yearThe iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max mark a fairly significant shift in Apple's flagship design and performance approach this year. Both models are powered by Apple's new A20 Pro chip, which the company describes as its most capable iPhone processor to date. The chip features a six-core CPU paired with a 7-core GPU, with each GPU core equipped with dedicated neural accelerators for improved AI processing.On the display front, the iPhone 18 Pro comes with a 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR screen supporting ProMotion technology at up to 120Hz, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max steps up to a larger 6.9-inch display with the same specifications. Both screens are protected by Ceramic Shield 2.This year, Apple has also shifted back to single-tone colour scheme for both Pro models, moving away from the two-tone design, featuring the same full-width camera plateau on the back. Notably, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max also debuts next-generation vapour chamber cooling system, the largest for Apple's flagship lineup, designed to help sustain performance during particularly demanding tasks like gaming or heavy multitasking.Camera-wise, both models feature a triple rear camera setup consisting of a 48MP main sensor, a 48MP ultrawide lens, and a 48MP telephoto lens. In a first, both these models come with variable aperture in the main camera. Both devices run on iOS 27 out of the box, bringing a refined Liquid Glass interface design along with a range of Apple Intelligence features.iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max price in IndiaIn India, the iPhone 18 Pro starts at Rs 1,64,900 for the base 256GB variant, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at Rs 1,79,900 for the same storage configuration. Both models are available in Black, Silver, Glacier and Burgundy colour options.Get the latest technology news and updates. Download the TOI App.
